prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:11 vertical natural 35mm field portrait of an adult woman with dark wavy hair and a calm relaxed expression. She wears a white cherry-patterned short-sleeve midi dress with a high rounded neckline, full skirt, and plain tan sandals. Seat her upright on a white wire chair in a dry grassy field, hands on chair arms and both feet naturally placed on the ground. Use eye-level full-body composition, warm low-angle golden sunlight, softly blurred distant trees, warm grain, natural skin, dress texture, accurate hands, and balanced anatomy. No exact face reference, bare-foot focus, logo, readable text, brand, or watermark.
